basics.name: Ruixian Hao
basics.label: M.S. Student in Surveying and Mapping Science and Technology
basics.summary: Ruixian Hao is a graduate student at the College of Geoscience and Surveying Engineering, China University of Mining and Technology - Beijing. His research focuses on GNSS meteorology, tropospheric delay modeling, atmospheric water vapor, GNSS water vapor tomography, and GNSS reflectometry for water-level and sea-surface-height retrieval.

work.name: National Key Laboratory of Air-Ground Integrated New Navigation System Technology, Beihang University
work.summary: GNSS ionospheric scintillation and civil aviation positioning research.
highlights: Studied the influence of ionospheric scintillation on civil aviation positioning using ADS-B trajectory data.

Processed GNSS carrier-phase observations, applied dual-frequency ionosphere-free combinations, and removed orbit, clock, tropospheric, and relativistic effects before estimating residual-based scintillation indicators.

projects.name: ERA5-SH: Scale-height dataset for tropospheric parameters
projects.summary: Global gridded scale-height dataset based on ERA5 pressure-level reanalysis profiles.
highlights: Calculated vertical profiles for ZTD, ZWD, ZHD, Tm, PWV, and WVD from ERA5 reanalysis data.
Estimated scale heights through exponential fitting and evaluated product accuracy with 591 global radiosonde stations from 2022.
Published as a Scientific Data paper and released supporting code on GitHub.

projects.name: GMR-Water: GNSS-MR water-level retrieval software
projects.summary: MATLAB software for water-level retrieval using GNSS multipath reflectometry.
highlights: Integrated spectral analysis, inverse modeling, carrier/pseudo-range combinations, and multi-frequency fusion methods.
Supports SNR, carrier phase, and pseudo-range based retrieval with visualization and accuracy evaluation.
Provides GUI and scripted workflows for reproducible and batch processing.

projects.name: Spatial-temporal variation of water vapor scale height in China
projects.summary: Analysis of water vapor scale-height characteristics and impact factors across Chinese climate zones.
highlights: Used radiosonde observations from 89 Chinese stations to calculate water vapor scale height from 2016 to 2019.
Analyzed spatial-temporal variation patterns and impact factors across climate regions.
Published in Advances in Space Research.
